title: The Cress Tray by the South Window
youtube_title: The Cress Tray by the South Window | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Leaving a cover on is a kind of trust.
summary: At a quiet craft corner with paper, paste, and a wooden rack, Violeta wants to check on a tray of cress at the south window before it is ready. With Auntie Luz nearby, Violeta leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
